newsitem.title: UK: TLG shares up from doldrums after H1 result.
newsitem.headline: TLG shares up from doldrums after H1 result.

text.p: Shares in light fitting group TLG Plc bounced higher on Wednesday after first-half results provided no fresh shocks after its profit warning in September and the company raised the prospect of better days to come.
TLG shares were up 8-1/2p at 101-1/2p by 1125 GMT, after on Tuesday closing at their lowest level since the stock was spun off from Thorn EMI in 1994.
TLG said that for the six months to September 30, pre-tax profits slipped to 8.3 million stg from 11.4 million, in line with previously-stated expectations.
